title: Initial correctness smoke run
status: Illustrative local smoke result — not a benchmark
notes: Both backends consumed the same deterministic point snapshot on every tick.
The observed backend center delta was approximately 2.260e-9.
Displayed time includes upload, GPU execution, synchronization, readback and drawing.
The first tick includes pipeline and driver warm-up and should not be compared.
A repeatable benchmark needs warm-up, many samples, isolated backends and timestamp queries when available.
